title: 18. How do I import an existing survey from my computer?
intent: This article helps EUSurvey survey managers understand or perform the task: How do I import an existing survey from my computer.
short_answer: On the 'Welcome' page or the 'Surveys' page, click on 'New Survey' 'Import Survey' option and a dialogue box will open. Once you have selected a survey file from your computer, click on 'Import' and your survey will be added to EUSurvey.
procedure: Note: you can only import surveys as zip files or with the file extension .eus.
important_conditions: Note: you can only import surveys as zip files or with the file extension .eus.
